source_row.stem: A nurse provides dietary teaching for a client with heart failure on a low-sodium diet. The nurse should advise the client to:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Add extra table salt to compensate for bland taste","B":"Sodium restriction has no relevance to heart failure","C":"Increase intake of processed and canned foods without much regard for their sodium content","D":"Read food labels for sodium content and limit high-sodium processed foods, favoring fresh, whole foods"}}
source_row.rationale: Dietary teaching for a low-sodium diet in heart failure includes reading food labels for sodium content, limiting high-sodium processed foods, and favoring fresh, whole foods to help manage fluid retention.
source_row.source_name: AHA — Sodium Restriction in Heart Failure
